title: tokens-bruecke tokens snapshot
description: A snapshot of a Figma file's local variables and styles, passed to the tokens-bruecke CLI via --input. Objects use the raw Figma Plugin API shapes verbatim, so a dump from figma.variables.getLocalVariablesAsync(), figma.getLocalPaintStylesAsync(), etc. can be serialized as-is with no reshaping. Extra properties are allowed and ignored.

variableCollections.description: Local variable collections, as returned by figma.variables.getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync(). Exclude remote (library) collections.

variables.description: Local variables, as returned by figma.variables.getLocalVariablesAsync(). Exclude remote (library) variables.

paintStyles.description: Local paint styles, as returned by figma.getLocalPaintStylesAsync(). Only exported when includedStyles.colors.isIncluded is true in the config.

textStyles.description: Local text styles, as returned by figma.getLocalTextStylesAsync(). Only exported when includedStyles.text.isIncluded is true in the config.

effectStyles.description: Local effect styles, as returned by figma.getLocalEffectStylesAsync(). Only exported when includedStyles.effects.isIncluded is true in the config.

gridStyles.description: Local grid styles, as returned by figma.getLocalGridStylesAsync(). Only exported when includedStyles.grids.isIncluded is true in the config.

id.description: Collection id, referenced by each variable's variableCollectionId.

name.description: Collection name. Becomes the top-level token group unless omitCollectionNames is set.

modes.description: Modes in this collection. modeId keys the variable's valuesByMode map; name is used for mode groups and --split-by-mode filenames.

defaultModeId.description: Mode used for a token's primary $value. Other modes land in $extensions.mode.

variableIds.description: Variable ids in the order shown in Figma's Variables panel. Preserves token ordering in the output; without it, output order follows the variables array.

id.description: Variable id. Alias values reference this id, so every aliased variable must be present in the snapshot.

name.description: Variable name. Slashes become nested token groups ("colors/primary" -> colors.primary).

variableCollectionId.description: Id of the collection this variable belongs to.

resolvedType.description: Figma variable type. Drives the token $type.

valuesByMode.description: Value per modeId. Keys are modeIds from the collection's modes array, not mode names.

description.description: Variable description. Emitted as the token $description.

scopes.description: Figma variable scopes. Emitted in $extensions when includeScopes is enabled, and used to refine FLOAT tokens (e.g. FONT_WEIGHT, OPACITY). Defaults to an empty array when omitted.

codeSyntax.description: Per-platform code syntax (WEB, ANDROID, iOS). Emitted when includeFigmaMetaData is enabled.

remote.description: Should be false — remote (library) variables are expected to be filtered out of the snapshot.

variableValue.description: A resolved variable value, or an alias pointing at another variable.

variableAlias.description: Reference to another variable. If the target id is not present in the snapshot (e.g. a library variable), the token value resolves to "#missing#" — the same behaviour as the REST API resolver.

rgba.description: Color in 0..1 float channels, as the Plugin API returns it. Alpha defaults to 1 when absent.

paintStyle.description: Figma PaintStyle. boundVariables.paints[] (Plugin API shape) makes a variable-bound color style export as an alias rather than a literal color.

paints.description: Paint objects. Solid paints carry a `color` in 0..1 channels plus an optional `opacity`.

textStyle.description: Figma TextStyle, as returned by figma.getLocalTextStylesAsync().

effectStyle.description: Figma EffectStyle, as returned by figma.getLocalEffectStylesAsync().

gridStyle.description: Figma GridStyle, as returned by figma.getLocalGridStylesAsync().
